title: App Surface Store Provisioning Semantics
authority_scope: Defines store-facing app identity, version authority, metadata, preview media, and store compliance checklist semantics for app-surface release work.

semantic_models.title: Apple Developer and App Store Connect account prerequisites
semantic_models.purpose: Define prerequisite semantics for Apple Developer and App Store Connect account standing, ownership, release authority, privacy, entitlement, proof, validator, dependency, and non-claim mappings.
required_mappings: Apple account prerequisites must identify account standing, team ownership, role boundaries, release authority, privacy obligations, entitlement prerequisites, and evidence expectations.
Apple account prerequisite semantics must not create an account, assign roles, handle credentials, submit an app, or assert legal approval.
Release authority must remain separate from build execution and store submission execution.
Missing, unknown, or stale account evidence must fail closed for any App Store readiness claim.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future validators must reject Apple account prerequisite claims that lack account standing, ownership, role, release authority, privacy, entitlement, evidence, or non-claim mappings.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve Apple account standing, role boundary, release authority, privacy and entitlement prerequisite evidence, and readiness non-claims before any store-facing claim is made.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No Apple account creation, role assignment, credential handling, app submission, legal conclusion, or readiness claim is authorized by this model.

semantic_models.title: Google Play Console account prerequisites
semantic_models.purpose: Define prerequisite semantics for Google Play Console account standing, ownership, release authority, Data Safety, signing, track, proof, validator, dependency, and non-claim mappings.
required_mappings: Google Play account prerequisites must identify account standing, ownership, release authority, Data Safety obligations, app signing posture, track prerequisites, and evidence expectations.
Google Play prerequisite semantics must not create an account, handle credentials, upload a build, submit a release, or assert legal approval.
Data Safety and app signing prerequisites must remain traceable to governed privacy and release semantics.
Missing, unknown, or stale account evidence must fail closed for any Google Play readiness claim.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future validators must reject Google Play account prerequisite claims that lack account standing, ownership, release authority, Data Safety, signing, track, evidence, or non-claim mappings.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve Google Play account standing, release authority, Data Safety, signing, track prerequisite evidence, and readiness non-claims before any store-facing claim is made.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No Google Play account creation, credential handling, build upload, release submission, legal conclusion, or readiness claim is authorized by this model.

semantic_models.title: Bundle ID package name and version authority
semantic_models.purpose: Define the authority boundary for bundle identifiers, package names, display identity, version names, build numbers, and release identity.
required_mappings: Each app identity value must have one governed semantic source and must not be inferred from implementation structure.
Bundle ID, package name, version name, and build number must be represented as separate release identity dimensions.
Version and build-number authority must be traceable to a release gate and must not imply store readiness.
Naming values must comply with the directory and file naming standard where repository artefacts are involved.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future release validators must fail closed when app identity, version name, build number, or release identity is missing, duplicated, implementation-derived, or inconsistent with governed metadata.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve the governed app identity and version mapping used for a release candidate before any store-facing claim is made.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No app creation, bundle registration, package publishing, build execution, or store submission is authorized by this model.

semantic_models.title: Store metadata generation
semantic_models.purpose: Define the semantic contract for app names, descriptions, categories, privacy labels, Data Safety mappings, policy links, localization, and screenshot references.
required_mappings: Store metadata must be derived from governed capability, privacy, accessibility, and locale semantics rather than marketing inference.
Privacy labels and Data Safety fields must reference the privacy disclosure and compliance proof semantics.
Policy links, support links, and marketing descriptions must be classified as store metadata claims and must not exceed validated USF semantics.
Localized metadata must identify the locale and source semantic claim for each localized field.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future validators must reject store metadata that lacks a governed source, conflicts with privacy disclosures, omits required locale mapping, or claims readiness beyond available evidence.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve generated metadata inputs, source semantic references, locale mappings, and reviewer-facing claim boundaries.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No metadata upload, asset generation, store submission, legal approval, or privacy compliance conclusion is authorized by this model.

semantic_models.title: Store screenshots and preview media
semantic_models.purpose: Define preview media semantics for screenshots, videos, localization, fixture privacy, accessibility, platform requirements, and metadata linkage.
required_mappings: Each preview asset must map to a governed UI capability, locale, platform, and privacy-safe fixture source.
Preview media must not expose personal data, credentials, provider secrets, or unapproved production data.
Preview media must reference accessibility semantics when it visually represents text, contrast, controls, or user flows.
Preview media requirements must remain separate from actual asset generation and store upload execution.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future validators must reject preview media evidence that lacks governed capability mapping, locale mapping, privacy-safe fixture provenance, platform classification, or metadata linkage.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve asset source inputs, fixture privacy classification, locale, platform, and linked metadata claim for each store-facing preview item.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No screenshot generation, preview media generation, asset upload, store submission, product UI readiness, or production readiness is authorized by this model.

semantic_models.title: Store privacy compliance submission checklist
semantic_models.purpose: Define checklist semantics for privacy labels, Data Safety, tracking prompts, policy links, consent, SDK registry linkage, validation, and proof.
required_mappings: Checklist items must reference governed privacy disclosure, SDK vendor, consent, data inventory, and compliance proof semantics.
A checklist item may indicate required evidence, missing evidence, or owner review requiring evidence, but must not assert legal approval without explicit authority.
Store privacy fields must be traceable to the same semantic source used by metadata generation.
Unknown, stale, or missing evidence must fail closed for any store compliance claim.
semantic_models.validator_requirement: Future validators must reject checklist evidence that is missing, stale, inconsistent with privacy disclosure semantics, inconsistent with SDK registry semantics, or used as a legal compliance conclusion.
semantic_models.proof_requirement: Future proof must preserve checklist source inputs, privacy mapping references, evidence freshness, owner-review status, and non-claim boundaries.
semantic_models.implementation_gate: No legal conclusion, compliance approval, checklist execution, store submission, or production readiness is authorized by this model.

dependency_policy.semantic_closure_meaning: A covered issue may be closed only as a semantic-definition work item when its model, validator requirement, proof requirement, dependency mapping, implementation gate, and non-claims are recorded.
dependency_policy.execution_claim_boundary: Dependency mapping in this artefact does not satisfy execution, release, provider, store, compliance, approval, or production prerequisites.
execution_evidence_requirements: USF-704 owner decision for store account ownership and release authority

evidence_freshness_semantics.missing: Missing evidence must not satisfy any checklist, metadata, preview media, identity, release, compliance, or readiness claim.
evidence_freshness_semantics.unknown: Unknown evidence status must not satisfy pass.
evidence_freshness_semantics.stale: Stale evidence status must not satisfy pass.
evidence_freshness_semantics.generated_reports: Generated store reports are lower authority than raw evidence and semantic definitions.

non_claims: This artefact does not claim App Store readiness.
This artefact does not claim Google Play readiness.
This artefact does not claim privacy compliance.
This artefact does not claim legal approval.
This artefact does not claim production readiness.
This artefact does not claim live-provider readiness.
